messages:
maya: Heads up — release CI is blocked by a weird regen diff on feature/regen-idempotence. It flags README snippets and changelog array order as a breaking change.

hugo: Saw that. The diff shows only ordering changes in generated docs, but semver guard is treating it as a surface change and blocking the publish.

regen-bot: pipeline: typegen-run #5013 failed (exit 2). Attach: /artifacts/typegen/2949999999/regendiff.log

maya: Example from the diff: 
```diff
-  - notes: ["init", "migration"]
+  - notes: ["migration", "init"]
```

lia: Our doc comparator is sensitive to array ordering in meta sections (changelogs, examples). Those don't affect runtime contract, but they trip the semver checker.

corey: Additionally, python and ts SDK READMEs now show different default retry policies after regen. That makes sampleapp smoketests flip between passing/failing.

hugo: Can we make two changes: 1) relax semver guard to ignore changes that only touch docs/ or changelog_metadata/*; 2) add a regen-idempotence CI check that runs `./scripts/regen` twice and fails if git shows diffs?

maya: I like that. For (1) we should still surface a warning in the release UI so reviews can confirm nothing contract-related changed. Don't want silent masking.

lia: For the idempotence check, we should run it only for PRs touching generators or openapi specs to save CI minutes. And keep it optional for other PRs.

corey: I'll open a tiny PR that canonicalizes array sorting for changelog metadata and normalizes example block formatting in the generator. Should cut down on noise.

hugo: Also add a parity check that compares generated SDK READMEs for auth/retry doc blocks across languages — if they differ, fail a DX test and surface to `/eng/devex` channel.

maya: Good. Short-term patch: semver guard => WARN for docs-only diffs, and unblock this release manually. Filing: https://redwood-internal/ops/INC-2034-regen-doc-noise

corey: Drafting generator fix now. Will target stable-ref-resolution and array-normalization. Expect PR in the next few hours.

lia: Once that lands, we should backfill a test that runs regen twice on a matrix of sampleapis to catch non-determinism.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release checklist and unstick the pipeline once semver guard change is merged. :white_check_mark:
